data_manifest.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0 as declared by corpus maintainer; local noncommercial research, source attribution in language-material provenance.
data_manifest.split: Grouped by normalized leading96 characters; 98/1/1 hash split, max512 heldout per kind. Exact text dedup across sources. Not exhaustive semantic near-dedup.
data_manifest.sampling: Hash-selected quarter of accepted source documents, capped100k per source; still capped source-order bias. Identity filters expanded after v1 sample audit.
data_manifest.limitations: Regex filters are imperfect, factual correctness not established. Reuses v2 train-only vocabulary, including word pieces from subsequently filtered TRAIN documents; no heldout vocabulary fitting. No pretrained weights.

data_audit.scope: All normalized groups/exact digests; 16-character nonoverlapping sampled shingles, >=8 shared and80% containment. Misses shifted/paraphrased near duplicates; not semantic isolation proof.
